profile.headline: a management firmware/software specialist of Cluster supercomputer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 12+ years in hands-on development in the HPC/Cluster Supercomputer environment. Designed and developed numerous low-level cluster management solutions on large scale compute/GPU nodes.

Relevant Skills:
- Bring-up and debug brand-new ARM based board using kgdb, gdb-server, qmeu and JTAG
- Kernel mode debugging: gdb-server, kgdb, qemu and JTAG
- Thermal/Power/Health management for CPU/PCIe/NVMe/PLX/GPU and custom FPGA
- Management Standard: IPMI(RMCP+, IPMI_SI, IPMB), SNMP and Redfish on BMC/ME
- Device driver for: PCIe, I2C master/slave/mux,  GPIO, SPI, CAN, UART, USB, IPMB
- API for HW components: PMBus PMIC, hot-swap controller, GPIO, SEEP, NVRAM, Fan Controller and Health Monitoring Chip
- HW engineering: review schematic and datasheet and debug HW logic design
- HW troubleshooting using equipment: oscilloscope, logic analyzer, DVM

Programming Skills:
- C, C++, Ksh,Bash, Python, automake/autoconf, Java, Perl
- TCP/UDP Socket programming and basic SQL/HTTP
- Linux/Unix Multi-core with NUMA and Multi Thread with semaphore/mutex
- Linux kernel/user space device drivers and API/shared library
- Cross platform development environment: gnu-eabi cross toolchain, gdb-server on x86, ARM and QEMU
- Embedded linux target images and distribution package: u-boot , linux kernel, init scripts, daemons, rootfs(ext4,cramfs,jffs2), LTIB and RPM
- GIT, SVN, Stash, Jira, Bugzilla for source code control and issue tracking

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed firmware/software development for the cluster management solution of the Cray cluster products such as Urika-GX, CS-Storm, CS400 and CS500.

Worked with the hardware team for new branding of the platform HW:
  - Brought-up the Freescale iMX6 ARM based cluster management controller.
  - Brought-up and validated engineering sample PCA components and prototype chassis.
  - Troubleshot HW issues such as i2c bus lock-up and signal quality.

Developed/Implemented/Integrated the cluster management features:
  - Developed real-time event logging and notification over Rsyslog/SNMP-Trap/E-mail.
  - Implemented redundant management capability on single-rail and dual-rail management network.
  - Developed In-system firmware flashing solution with permanent MAC address fusing.
  - Developed Cray VPD/FRU/SNMP capability for hw platform components.
  - Developed user space driver library and application for power consumption monitoring and energy counting of Redundant Power Supply System. (N+1, N+N).
  - Designed compute Node monitoring solution: Power usage(W, V, A), Energy saving(Wh) and Health(State,Thermal Sensor) for nVidia CUDA GPU(SMBPBI)/Intel MIC/PLX SW/NVMe.

Troubleshot and debugged the Cray cluster components:
  - Wrote diagnostic tools for platform HW components: Processor, Memory, GPU, Power Supply Unit and shared cooling fan.
  - Solved PCIe/SATA/I2C issue using logic analyzer with HW Engineer.
  - Provided checklist template of platform HW components for the Manufacturing and Production Floor.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Appro was acquired by Cray in 2012 and we merged into the Cray R&D Division.

Contributed firmware development and brought-up the brand-new Freescale iMX25 based compute blade controller and software stack. Reviewed and provided feedback for the HW platform design/schematic of Appro Tetra, GreenBlade1/2.

Developed and integrated for the compute blade management features:
  - Built standalone embedded linux firmware images and distribution packages.
  - Integrated kernel/user space device driver and API into the firmware images.
  - Developed fault tolerant remote firmware update utility for customer site.
  - Developed protocol API between the management controller and Intel BMC/ME via IPMB and SMBus.
  - Implemented various cooling algorithm and WDT HW logic for real-time thermal protection. 
  - Integrated ASETEK liquid cooling CDU into the management solution.

Troubleshot and debugged the Appro Clusters/Servers:
  - Wrote diagnostic tools for platform HW components: Processor, Memory, nVidia GPU, Power Supply Unit and shared cooling fan.
  - Improved kernel space device drivers of i2c-master/mux and gpio for large scale SMBus infrastructure (covers 16x blade nodes per subrack chassis)
  - Performed analysis on-site issues to determine problem causes between HW and SW.
